message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.wash: You wake to the sound of the tide.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.in: Follow the signs of civilization inland.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.gr: Follow the ruined road toward the graveyard.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.unde: An Undertaker is looting the graves ahead.
The graveyard threat has passed. The Undertaker has reached %s.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.re: Aid the region. Defeat any two local threats.
%s speaks of a grave robber on the coast road.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.resp: %s takes you in. Should you fall, you will wake here again — %s, %s, %s.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.rave: A dark route has opened. Follow it to the Sculken Raven.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.sett: Raiders fall upon %s! Stand with the townsfolk and drive them out.
The raid is broken. %s holds because of you.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.da: Investigate the Dark Forest. The unnatural howls betray the empty land.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.ot: Warn %s. Follow the trade road %s to reach it before the raiders do.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.cr: Investigate Devil's Crossing. Follow the ruined trade road %s.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.fore: The forest has gone unnaturally still.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.prey: Something has swept through the herd. One of the animals is simply gone.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.drea: The forest drinks deeply of the slaughter. The unseen dread surges.
Darkness moves between the trees. Two eyes burn within it.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.cros: Devil's Crossing is destroyed. There is no sign of what did this.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.in: Investigate the disturbed ground around Devil's Crossing.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.cros: The tracks below the ruins are becoming clearer: %s%%
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.thra: The earth beneath Devil's Crossing begins to thrash.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.cros: The churned ground splits open. The drowned dead of Devil's Crossing claw their way up — and the sun does not touch them.
Another wave tears itself free of the earth. (%s/%s)
The last of the risen dead falls still. Devil's Crossing is quiet once more.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.scul: The land here is wrong — a spreading crust of sculk, listening. Sensors twitch and shriekers wait.
The sculk drinks its fill of the dead. The ground splits and a Sculken Raven tears free.
The sculk births more soldiers — draugrs rise. (%s/%s)
The Sculken Raven collapses into inert sculk. The listening land goes still.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.worl: Act I is preparing the world. Please wait. If preparation does not finish, leave and restart the world.
Act I could not resolve its story locations. Leave and restart the world. If the problem continues, use /campaign washed_ashore reset.
Act I encountered a world-generation problem. Restart the world before continuing; use /campaign washed_ashore inspect for details.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.futu: Survey stakes mark this land for settlement. Civilization will take root here later.
message.campaign_core.washed_ashore.hub_: %s construction has begun. Do not leave or stop the world until placement finishes.
%s construction is complete. It is now safe to stop the world.
A Settlement is currently being constructed. Do not leave or stop the world until completion is announced.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.de: Investigate Devil's Crossing along the ruined trade road.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.di: Warn %s and help it stand against the raiders.
objective.campaign_core.washed_ashore.sh: Press the Show Available Quests key to review your quests and reveal their markers.
Quest complete: available quests and their markers revealed.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.hosti: %s calls for aid: hostile wolves are closing on the sheep!
The flock is safe and the wolves have been driven off.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.slime: A family of slimes is multiplying around %s!
The slime infestation has been cleared.
The slimes continue to spread around %s.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.chick: An unlikely wave of chicken jockeys is racing toward %s!
The chicken jockey charge has been stopped.
The strange chicken-mounted horde escaped justice.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.restl: Devil's Crossing seeks brave adventurers: the Undertaker walks the graveyard once more, stronger than before.
The restless Undertaker has been laid low again.
The Undertaker still prowls the graveyard.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.rampa: A rampaging ravager is bearing down on Devil's Crossing!
The ravager will trample the crossing no longer.
The ravager remains a threat to the crossing.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.prosp: Six prospectors near Devil's Crossing are under attack. At least two must survive!
The surviving prospectors are returning safely from Devil's Crossing.
Too few prospectors survived the undead assault.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.evoke: Evokers have begun a forbidden ritual on the outskirts of %s!
The evokers' ritual has been broken.
The evokers completed their work and disappeared.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.consu: The Consuming Dread has been destroyed before reaching %s.
The Consuming Dread escaped into the surrounding wilds.
message.campaign_core.hub_incident.raven: A Sculken Raven and a weakened Warden are battling on the outskirts of %s!
The monstrous clash on the outskirts has ended.
The battling monsters vanished into the wilds.
screen.campaign_core.quest_markers.none: No points of interest have been revealed yet.
message.campaign_core.natural_anchor_dis: A weathered beach marker points toward another chapter of the Washed Ashore story...
